params.name: identifier
params.description: The identifier of the media provider containing the media to rate.  Typically `com.plexapp.plugins.library`

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the item to rate.  This is the `ratingKey` found in metadata items

params.name: uri
params.description: The URI of the item to mark as played.  See intro for description of the URIs

items.docs:
Mark an item as played.  Note, this does not create any view history of this item but rather just sets the state as played. The client must provide either the `key` or `uri` query parameter
This API does respond to the GET verb but applications should use PUT

params.name: key
params.description: The details key for the item.

params.name: ratingKey
params.description: The rating key attribute for the item.

params.name: state
params.description: The current state of the media.

params.name: playQueueItemID
params.description: If playing media from a play queue, the play queue's ID.

params.name: time
params.description: The current time offset of playback in ms.

params.name: duration
params.description: The total duration of the item in ms.

params.name: continuing
params.description: When state is `stopped`, a flag indicating whether or not the client is going to continue playing anothe item.

params.name: updated
params.description: Used when a sync client comes online and is syncing media timelines, holds the time at which the playback state was last updated.

params.name: offline
params.description: Also used by sync clients, used to indicate that a timeline is being synced from being offline, as opposed to being "live".

params.name: timeToFirstFrame
params.description: Time in seconds till first frame is displayed.  Sent only on the first playing timeline request.

params.name: timeStalled
params.description: Time in seconds spent buffering since last request.

params.name: bandwidth
params.description: Bandwidth in kbps as estimated by the client.

params.name: bufferedTime
params.description: Amount of time in seconds buffered by client.  Omit if computed by `bufferedSize` below.

params.name: bufferedSize
params.description: Size in kilobytes of data buffered by client.  Omit if computed by `bufferedTime` above

items.docs: This endpoint is hit during media playback for an item. It must be hit whenever the play state changes, or in the absence of a play state change, in a regular fashion (generally this means every 10 seconds on a LAN/WAN, and every 20 seconds over cellular).
